message: Canny is a feedback management tool that pulls feature requests out of support tickets, sales calls and chat into one place, deduplicates them, and tracks them for product decisions. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: On the $0 Free plan (25 tracked users, unlimited Autopilot credits/sources), a product team connects the conversation sources it already has — Gong calls, Intercom/Zendesk support tickets, and other Autopilot sources — so Autopilot reads those conversations, pulls out feature requests, merges detected duplicates, and triages them to the right team in one place. This answers the 'yet another tool plus more manual triage work' objection without requiring a paid upgrade. Next step: start on Free and connect one existing source. Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
